description.value: Nobody Told Me is a bar and restaurant at 951 Amsterdam Ave near Columbia University. Its daily happy hour from 3 to 6pm includes $2 oysters and cheap draft beer. The kitchen and bar stay open until 2am every day, so it works for a late meal.
